§7■ The Dihuang Loong is born of the deep abyss, companion to rock, ore, and earth vein energy. Its scales are thick and hard, like deepslate compacted over eons; every breath, every step, echoes the rhythm of the earth. To them, the underground is the world of freedom; the surface and sunlight only remind them of their distance from the sky.§r
